text: *i open my eyes and wander to the forest opposite of the big city in front of me*
*i follow the sounds bow ready as i openly walk towards the voice*
Lost *i say calmly as i lower my Bow ready to turn around and continue hunting*
*i continue to track game trails*
*i follow the tracks towards teh smoke sneaking as i crouch and walk silently*
*i turn and say* how about you take that here and leave me alone and i leave your side of the water alone *i say and throw a silver coint to him*
*i open my eyes and walk towards the big city gate ahead of me*
*i put the bow on my back and give him one silver waiting for my change back* Can you point me to the adventurer guild?
*i follow his directions and enter the Guild hall*
*i look at them and bow slightly as i say* im new and this is my first branch. Im Alaric no family name
*i take the Rats in the cellars of Rennicks yard Quest and go back to the desk to register it* Ill see you later then Sponsor *i say and then start making my way to the cellar*
*i nod at her words and then get my arrows back. I then take the ears and make my way up again saying* ill leave the corpses to you Rennick *i then make my way back to the guild to turn the Quest in*
*i put the bow on my back and walk to the Big City Gate ahead of me*
*i nod and walk inside looking for the adventurer Hall*
*i walk to the Clerk* Hello im Alaric no family name and im new to the guild and want to register
18 and Ranger *i say as i pay the 2 silver and put my hand on the slate*
*i nod and walk to the F-Rank quest board*
*I take the Vermin in the Malthouse Cellar Quest and register it with by the desk and then travel there*
ill take a look *i say and get my bow ready as i go downstairs*
*i get the corpse and drag it with up. I then leave it with him and go back to the guild to turn the quest in*
Partly one dead one fled *i say* he paid a bit under half its fair
*i walk to the Gate of the City in front of me*
Hello im Alaric and im newly awakend. The sword was a gift and im here to register with the adventurer guild *i say smiling politely*
*i follow the directions he gave me and go to the guild and into the guild hall*
Alaric 18 Warrior F Rank
*i give her one Silver and say* the registration for now *i then make my way over to the F-Rank Quest Board*
*i take the Boletus Clearing Tannery Row Quest and register it at the front desk*
*i walk to the Tannery Row and look for Mol*
*I walk towards the Gate of the City Ahead
*i pay one copper as i wait for my change and say* My name is Alaric Red and im here to register with the adventurer Guild
*i follow the guards direction and walk to the guild and enter it*
Hello im Alaric Red im 18 and i want to register
Im a Warrior at F-Rank and i plan to sleep at an Inn for now since im new in this city *i say as i push the 2 silver over the counter to pay*
*i shake my head and walk to the Quest board to look at the F-Rank Quests*
*i take the Delivery Sealed Satchnel Quest and go to the front desk to register it and get the sealed item*
*i shake my head and travel towards the Salt Gate customshouse
*i Ring once and then wait*
Alaric Red Sir *i say politely and wait for my receipt for the done delivery*
*i make my way back to the guilds front desk and turn in the signature slip and the Quest overall*
*i walk to the gate of the City ahead of me*
*i quietly join the queue and follow it inisde the City where i then go to the adventurers guild and enter the guild hall*
*i walk up and say* Hello Im Alaric and i want to register
*I write down Alaric Red 18 Warrior no guild standings from a Village in the Kingdom and traveling the World* here *i say and give her the registration form back*
*i press until i bleed and then wait for the result*
*i shake my head and walk to the Novice board and look at the quests on it*
*i take the Rats Quest and register it at the front desk. I then travel to the Woolsack Tavern*
If you can get them out so i can cull them that would be most helpful *i say calmly as i get my sword ready*
*i walk forward into the city ahead and look for the adventurers guild before i walk inside the guild hall*
Morning im here to Register *i say smiling politely*
*i write down Alaric Red - 18 - no feud. I then push 2 silver over the counter paying the fee* thank you *i say and take the plate. I then walk to the Novice Quest Board looking at the Quests*
*i take the Rats in the Salt Cellar Quest and go to the front desk to register it. I then walk to the Gulls Rest ravern*
*i nod and get my sword ready. I then walk down the stairs*
*I walk into the city ahead of me and look for the adventurer guild. I then walk inside the guild building and to the front desk*
Hello Registration please *i say politely*
Alaric Red 18 Warrior no other Guild memberships elsewhere Valedorn yes first armed work *i say calmly and push 1 silver over the counter to pay the fee*
*i walk over to the Novice Rank Quest Board and look at the Quests there*
*i take the Granary Vermin Control Quest and register it with the front deskt. I then walk over to the granary*
*i nod get my sword ready and go downstairs into the first of three cellars*
*i walk deeper following the sounds of things moving*
*I get into a combat pose holding my sword low and ready*
*i walk into the city ahead of me and go to the adventurers guild and enter the building*
Hello im here to register *i say politely*
*i take the ink and write down Alaric Red 18 none none. I then come back and give her the form and pay the 1 silver*
*i take my badge and then i walk to the Novice Board to look at the Quests*
*i take the Rats Quest and go to the front desk to register it. I then walk to the Blue Ox Tavern*
then ill find out what it is *i say calmly and step forward pulling my sword ready*
stay here *i say to Bren and then walk into the hole in the wall sword ready for more*
*i go down the right path as i move deeper*
*i aim my sword and get ready for combat*
*i walk into the city ahead and to the adventurers guild and walk inside the guild building*
*i walk to the front desk and say* Hello im here to register
Alaric Red 18 i can read and write *i say and pay the 2 silver and then put my finger on the iron pin and let my blood drip on the sheet before i put my hand on the stone*
*i nod and then i walk over to the Novice Rank Board looking at the Quests*
*i take the Wolf Problem quest and register it at the front desk. I then travel to the Millbrook Hamlet*
Yes lets go. just bring me to the side and ill investigate and track them from there
yes *i say and start following the trail i found before turning and saying* go back it will be dangerous i got it *i then continue tracking the wolves alone
*i draw my sword and walk up openly ready to fight*
*I butcher the Wolves to loot them and take that loot as Proof. I then walk back to Millbrook*
Proof *i say dryly and put them on the floor* ill need a signature so i can get my silver at the guild
*i leave the heads there on the floor and find Reeve Aldous to get my signature and silver. I then walk back to the guild to turn the Quest in*
*i walk into the city ahead of me and go to the adventurer guild and enter the guild building*
Im here to Register *i say politely*
*i not and pay the 2 Silver. I then put my hand on the Stone and let it mess my Rank. After all is done i go and look at the Novice Quest Board*
*i take the Millers Run Escort Quest and go to the front desk and register it*
*since i have time untill tomorrow i register the Herb Run Quest too and travel to the reedbeds east of the mill leat*
*since i have the whole day i start carrying armfulls down the path*
*i start carrying it all back to the guild to turn it in and the Quest with it*
*i turn the Quest in at the front desk and then i go walk around the City looking for an Inn to sleep and wash my clothes and myself*
I'll take the Missing Dog one.
*i pull the Fence Repair slip off the board and hand it to the clerk*
Sign me up for the Herb Run.
Deal. I'll clear your well tomorrow morning.
*i nod slowly* Fine, I'll do it.
*I took the weasel contract and had the clerk log it under my name*
*i grab the Missing Dog slip and bring it to the desk*
i tkae the herb run and the missing dog quests
*i take the dog one*
*i take the rats quest*
*i took the herb run slip and registered it*
*i accept the well job, give him the heads and ask for the signature*
Could I take the escort job too?
*maybe the Herb Run would suit me... i keep reading*
If I took the weasel job, how long would it take?
Tomorrow I'll take the Fence Repair job.
I already took the Miller's Run this morning, remember?
*the clerk pins a new slip and says* someone should really take the dog job
I won't take the Weasel job, too dangerous for me.
"Will you clear the old well for me?" *the reeve asks, twisting his cap*
What does the well job pay?
Let me think about your well. I'll tell you tonight.
*i put the basket on the counter* Herb Run, done.
I'd like to hand in the marshmint contract.
*i report back to the clerk about the herb job*
*i head back to the guild to turn in the herbs*
*i turn the quest in*
*i hand in the escort contract*
*i carry the mint back and hand it in at the guild*
*i hand over the mint, collect my pay and leave for the inn*
*I handed the basket over and the clerk checked it*
Can I turn this in already, or do you need more?
*i think about turning in the herbs but want to gather a bit more first*
Later I'll turn it in at the guild.
I turned in the herb run earlier, so what else is there?
*the clerk takes the basket from me and marks the herb run complete*
I'm not handing anything in yet.
Should I turn the herbs in before dark?
*i head to Harrow's mill yard*
I walk back to the reedbeds.
*i go to the Guild*
*i leave the guild and look for an inn*
I set off for the Greenfold forest.
*i pack up camp and travel back to Redmarch*
*i make my way to the east gate and out towards the mill leat*
*I walked to the reedbeds and started gathering.*
*i head to the guild hall*
*i step back out into the lane and walk to the market*
Where is the nearest inn?
*i consider heading to the mill but it's getting dark*
Tomorrow at first light I'll be at Harrow's yard.
*i stay where i am and watch the carts go by*
I came here from the reedbeds this afternoon.
*the innkeeper walks off to the kitchen*
If I went into the city now, would the gate be open?
I'm not going anywhere until the clerk answers me.
*i pay for the room*
*i slide two silver across the counter*
*i toss him a silver coin*
Here, three copper for the whetstone. *i hand it over*
*i pay the innkeeper 2 copper for a mug of ale*
Fine, I'll pay the two silver.
*I paid the innkeeper for the room and went upstairs.*
How much for just the bath?
*i reach for my purse, then hesitate*
If I pay the fee now, do I get my plate today?
I paid you already this morning.
I'm not paying four copper for that.
*the clerk takes two silver out of my pouch*
All three, please: room, bath and laundry.
Deal.
Just the room, thanks.
I'll take the room and the stew.
I'll take the rope.
*i buy the lantern oil*
*i take the room, pay and go upstairs to sleep untill morning*
Too expensive, I'll pass.
Not interested, thanks.
No. I will not pay a fee to join.
Would you do the laundry for less?
*the innkeeper puts a bowl of stew in front of me*
Let me think about the rope.
If the room had a window, I would take it.
I'd like a room for the night.
Room, bath and laundry, whatever it costs.
*i ask for a hot bath if it is no more than 3 copper*
*i buy a loaf of bread from the baker next to the stall, if it is under 2 copper*
*i buy a basket at the market and then head to the reedbeds*
I'll take a room if it's under 5 copper.
What would a new sword cost here?
*i think about the stew, it smells good*
*i wonder if i should buy rope for the cellar job*
No thanks, I don't need lantern oil.
Tomorrow I will buy new boots.
*i offer the wolf pelts to the furrier*
I'll sell you these three pelts, but not under 30 copper.
*I sold the furrier two of the pelts*
How much would you give me for wolf pelts?
I'm keeping the pelts for now.
"I'll buy your pelts for twenty copper," *says the furrier*
*i hand the wolf heads to the reeve*
*i give the contract slip to Aldous so he can sign it*
Take this. *i give him my spare dagger*
*i give the clerk my plate so she can stamp it*
Should I give you the heads now?
*Aldous hands me a cup of water*
I gave you the heads an hour ago.
*i put the heads down on the table*
*i drop the torch into the stream*
*i keep the heads in the sack*
*i drink the healing potion*
*i eat a day of rations and then go to sleep*
I could drink the potion if the wound gets worse.
*i scoop up the pile of mint*
*i cut off the rat ears as proof and pocket them*
*i collect my arrows*
*i pick up my plate from the counter*
*i take the wolf heads as proof*
Is that enough mint for a full basket?
*i leave the dead rats where they are*
*the stallkeeper takes my coin and counts it*
I want to join the Guild.
Register me, please.
Put me down as a new member. Alaric Red.
*i register and pay whatever the fee is*
What do I need to register?
*i wonder if registering is even worth it*
I'm here to register with the Guild later today.
I'm not registering today, just looking.
I'd like to take the promotion exam to Proven.
*i ask the clerk to promote me to the next rank*
How many contracts do I need before I can be promoted?
*i check the board*
Let me look at the Proven contracts too.
*i read through the notices on the far wall*
What's on the board today?
*i glance at the public notice board by the well*
*i swap my rapier for the dagger*
*i put my armor back on*
*i take off my leather armor and lie down to sleep*
*i unbuckle my armor and hang it on the hook*
Should I wear the armor tonight?
*i keep my armor on*
*i draw my rapier and listen*
*i rest for an hour*
*i sleep until dawn*
*i go to bed*
*i wait here until evening*
*i spend the afternoon training with my blade in a quiet yard*
*i sharpen my blade and mend my gear for a while*
*i search the reeds for whatever made that trail*
*i gather marshmint until the basket is full*
*i run errands around town for the rest of the day*
*i work until noon*
*i keep watch for two hours and then sleep*
*i study the map of the region for an hour*
How long until dawn?
*i'd love to sleep for a week*
Tomorrow I'll train all day.
I gathered plenty yesterday.
I'm not tired, I won't sleep yet.
*i tell the clerk i'm dropping the Miller's Run*
I quit the escort contract.
I give up on the quest.
Should I drop the escort job?
*i look around the common room* Nice place. Is the stew any good?
*i remember the rats from my last town and smile* Those were the days.
"Two copper for the oil and it's yours," *the stallkeeper says. i shrug*
